text: You heard from the sentry that the merchant that\ncame to Sofya City was attacked by monsters.\nGo to Rakau Plains to confirm it!
Shreya and Mochelo were attacked by monsters that look like\na swarm of bees!\nDefeat the monsters to help them!
The queen of the bee monsters, Mieli, is angry.\nWhat she says is different from what Shreya tells you...\nCalm her down for now!
